data.note: free-run validation is against the FULL-ATTENTION A1 run; a true-window version is being generated

definitions.m_t: top1-top2 logit gap of the unperturbed A1 run (nats)
definitions.dm: stored change of that gap at r=0.1 (nats)
definitions.T_pred: min{t: rho >= rc_signed(t,u)}; -1 if no t crosses
definitions.obs: first t with free-run token != baseline token; -1 = never
definitions.A_after: mean over t>obs of (free token == baseline token)
definitions.A_late: A_after for t > obs+45 (past the echoed task sentence)
definitions.resync: >=20 identical consecutive post-flip tokens, or identical suffix >=20

headline.summary_mean_postflip_field_note: the stored field is a mean over ALL directions and the whole 300-token run, not a post-flip mean; non-flipped directions contribute 1.0
